items.title: M0 update existing execution plan with Cell 03 real-run milestones
items.context: Append the real Cell 03 execution sequence to the existing M2 provider execution plan instead of creating a new large document. The section must distinguish readiness artifacts from real result rows.
items.userSees: A single existing M2 plan shows M0-M9 for Cell 03 real execution.
excludes: provider calls in the planning-only edit

happy.desc: The plan contains a Cell 03 real execution section with M0-M9 and says provider calls remain disabled until the execution gate opens.

edge.desc: The plan explicitly says pre-run dollar guesses are not launch gates and postflight provider-reported usage is required.

adversarial.desc: The plan must not claim Cell 06, Phase 2, paper wording, product gates, or playbook activation are unlocked by Cell 03 readiness.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "B-991d Cell 03 Real Execution|Cell 03 Real Execution Story" docs/requirements/decisions/multi-model-ablation-m2-provider-execution-plan.md
verificationEvidence.note: The existing M2 provider execution plan now contains the B-991d Cell 03 Real Execution Story section and the B-991d M0-M9 real-execution ledger while provider calls remain disabled until the execution window opens.
The plan states pre-run dollar guesses are not launch gates and postflight provider-reported usage/cost accounting is required after execution.
The plan states Cell 02, Cell 04, Cell 06, Phase 2, paper wording, product gates, and playbook activation remain locked/out of scope; CHK-001 does not unlock them.

items.title: M1 preflight freeze check for current Cell 03 envelope
items.context: Before any provider call, rerun the local readiness checker and verify prompt digest, tool-surface digest, target snapshots, runner ownership, duplicate policy, and task inventory are unchanged.
excludes: modifying the frozen prompt without digest refresh

happy.desc: The checker passes and reports Cell 03 execution envelope frozen.

edge.desc: Any drift in prompt or tool digest requires re-freeze before provider execution.

adversarial.desc: Host labels such as Codex CLI cannot substitute for provider snapshots.

verificationEvidence.note: Checker passed with output: M2 provider execution checker passed; Cell 03 execution envelope: frozen.

Checker output confirms pre-run dollar guess is not required and postflight provider-reported usage is required after execution, so drift or missing postflight usage cannot be treated as complete execution evidence.
Checker output confirms provider calls remain disabled, no outcome records are present, and Cell 06 A2prime is blocked; host labels cannot substitute for the frozen dated provider-target envelope.

items.title: M2 define execution receipts and result-row contract
items.context: Create or update result schema and manifest requirements so every future row binds cellKey, task, scenario, repeat, executor snapshot, reviewer snapshot, prompt digest, tool digest, provider usage, and supersession metadata.
items.userSees: Every future Cell 03 row has a machine-checkable receipt contract.

happy.desc: A row contract describes all required binding fields.

edge.desc: Failed or retried rows remain auditable and cannot count twice.

adversarial.desc: Rows missing provider-reported usage or digest bindings are not formally usable.

verificationEvidence.note: Result-row policy document defines required binding fields, provider usage requirement, and one-final-row-per-cell-key behavior for formal Cell 03 rows.
Contract preserves failed/retried/void/superseded rows as auditable non-counting records and permits only one final formal row per cell key.

Contract makes rows non-formal for missing provider usage, missing digest bindings, host-label-only snapshots, duplicate final rows, fallback/model switch, and confirms Cell 06/Phase 2/playbook/product gates remain unaffected.
Existing provider execution checker still passes with provider calls disabled, Cell 03 envelope frozen, postflight provider usage required, and Cell 06 blocked.

items.title: M3 open Cell 03-only execution window
items.context: Record a bounded execution window for Cell 03 only. It may allow provider calls for ③ A4 E2 same-family rows only and must keep Cell 02, Cell 04, Cell 06, Phase 2, product gates, and paper claims disabled. Any change to B-6529-authored launch or authorization artifacts must record B-991d execution provenance and explicit supersession semantics, preserving B-6529 as the no-provider-call readiness evidence rather than rewriting its historical claim.
items.userSees: Cell 03 execution window is open under B-991d provenance; all other cells remain disabled and B-6529 remains historical readiness evidence.

happy.desc: Provider calls are enabled only for Cell 03 under the frozen envelope and the opening artifact records B-991d provenance.

edge.desc: Expired windows, model drift, or missing B-991d supersession provenance void affected rows.

adversarial.desc: Any attempt to enable other cells or overwrite B-6529 no-provider-call evidence fails local checks.

verificationEvidence.note: Checker passes and reports B-991d Cell 03 execution window open for Cell 03 only, B-6529 no-provider-call readiness evidence preserved, postflight provider-reported usage required, and Cell 06 blocked.

verificationEvidence.command: node -e <parse B-991d window drift and supersession policies>
verificationEvidence.note: Both launch and guardrail artifacts bind the B-991d window, preserve B-6529 readiness evidence, deny non-Cell03 cells and fallback, and make drift/missing-provenance rows nonformal.

Checker rejected 17 negative controls, including attempts to add Cell 06 to the B-991d window, remove B-991d provenance, allow provider fallback, retarget the runner to Cell 06, unlock Cell 06 sequencing, drift prompt/tool digests, or add result rows.
Scope contract check is non-blocking: business artifacts are allowed by the contract; only acknowledged ProofStory lifecycle metadata remains as reviewer-visible warning.

items.title: M4 run a small probe batch before full execution
items.context: Run a tiny bounded probe, such as 2-5 Cell 03 rows, to prove provider invocation, receipt capture, result writing, duplicate handling, and postflight usage accounting before the 1,152-row run.
items.userSees: A small probe creates valid rows with usage and receipts.

happy.desc: Probe rows validate against the row contract.

edge.desc: A failed probe is recorded as failed and does not unlock full run.

adversarial.desc: Fallback provider or missing snapshot makes the row unusable.

verificationEvidence.note: A fresh B-991d Cell 03 probe produced 2 final rows. Each row includes executor usage, fresh same-family reviewer usage, SHIP verdict, aggregate provider usage, acceptance pass, hidden ground-truth pass, B-991d provenance, and fullRunUnlocked=true for CHK-006.

Probe validator simulates a failed/nonformal row and confirms it cannot unlock the full run. It also confirms provider-visible artifact workspaces contain only prompt.md, acceptance.mjs, task.json, and solution.mjs; hidden oracle/reference files are not visible to executor or reviewer.

Validator passed 225 assertions and rejected 15 negative controls, including duplicate cell keys, Cell 06 row, missing B-991d provenance, missing provider usage, fallback runner, missing reviewer snapshot, parent repo rules visible, hidden oracle visible, hidden file listed as visible, missing review gate, reviewer family drift, invalid verdict, missing reviewer usage, non-fresh reviewer context, and missing ground truth. M2 provider checker passed 1481 assertions with Cell 06, Phase 2, and outcome records blocked.

items.title: M5 run full Cell 03 1,152-row execution
items.context: Execute the full 24 task x 16 scenario x 3 repeat Cell 03 matrix only after the probe passes, preserving one formal row per cell key and auditable retry supersession.
items.userSees: 1,152 Cell 03 rows are present or each missing or failed key is explicitly accounted for.

happy.desc: All 1,152 expected cell keys have valid final status.

edge.desc: Timeouts and failures are represented without corrupting row counts.

adversarial.desc: Duplicate or unbound rows are rejected.

verificationEvidence.note: Cell 03 full validator passed: 106607 assertions, 13 negative controls rejected; finalRows=1142/1152, terminalExhaustedRows=10, pendingExecutableRows=0, requireComplete=true.
Validator accepts terminalExhaustedRows=10 as accounted terminal rows while requiring pendingExecutableRows=0, so timeouts/failures do not corrupt final row counts.
Validator rejected negative controls including duplicate final row, Cell 06 row, missing B-991d provenance, missing provider usage, missing review gate, and missing ground truth.

items.title: M6 postflight provider usage and cost accounting
items.context: Calculate actual usage and derived cost from provider-reported usage after execution. Estimates remain diagnostics only and cannot substitute for final usage.
items.userSees: Actual provider-reported usage and derived cost are summarized after the run.
excludes: pre-run dollar caps as launch gates

happy.desc: Usage summary is derived from provider-reported fields.

edge.desc: Missing provider usage keeps affected rows non-formal.

verificationEvidence.note: m2-status.md documents Cell 03 usage accounting, the exact token totals, and the no-fake-dollar-cost boundary.
Full validator rejects a final row with missing providerReportedUsage; usage-summary coverage is all_final_rows, so missing provider usage cannot be silently formal.
Current executable checker verifies usage-summary keeps exactProviderCostUsd null, does not fake dollar cost, and estimates do not gate launch or downstream execution.

items.title: M7 derive Cell 03 usage lock for downstream A2prime sequencing
items.context: After Cell 03 records are complete, derive the real usage or baseline lock needed by Cell 06 A2prime. This creates a dependency artifact but does not execute Cell 06.
items.userSees: Cell 06 has a real dependency lock but remains a separate story.

happy.desc: A lock artifact is derived from actual Cell 03 rows and usage.

edge.desc: Incomplete Cell 03 rows prevent lock finalization.

adversarial.desc: Example or declaration-only locks are rejected.

verificationEvidence.note: cell03-usage-lock.json is derived from actual Cell 03 rows/usage, contains 24 task locks, and has lockDigest sha256:160d695ec8ca94dd57a309bc90ce77af34718ab0151feee24206b08eea266242.
Current executable checker verifies usage lock prerequisites: Cell03 complete, pendingExecutableRows is 0, provider usage covers all final rows, and usage totals match the row artifacts.
Current executable checker rejects declaration-only/example locks and verifies cell03-usage-lock does not authorize Cell06 execution, Phase2, paper claims, product gates, or playbook activation.

items.title: M8 analysis readiness without paper overclaiming
items.context: Make Cell 03 results analyzable while preserving claim boundaries: no model-agnostic, H-M1, H-M3, or Phase 2 claim is unlocked by this story alone.
items.userSees: Cell 03 data is ready for later analysis, not overstated as a paper conclusion.
excludes: paper wording changes unsupported by full Phase 1 analysis

happy.desc: Analysis readiness states exactly what Cell 03 can and cannot support.

edge.desc: Partial rows are labeled partial and excluded from confirmatory claims.

adversarial.desc: Runtime, product, and playbook gates remain unaffected.

verificationEvidence.note: m2-status.md documents that Cell 03 is analysis-ready only descriptively and blocks model-agnostic, Phase 2, product, paper, and playbook claims.
partialDataHandling marks terminal exhausted rows as attrition/accounting only, not successful recoveries or formal final rows.
blockedClaims include runtime_product_gate_or_playbook_activation, paper wording, Phase 2, H-M1, H-M3, and model-agnostic claim blockers.

items.title: M9 DONE closure with delivery check and cost/claim summary
items.context: Close the Cell 03 execution story only after delivery-check verifies result rows, postflight provider-reported usage and derived cost, B-991d provenance, and claim boundaries. DONE summary must state what ran, actual usage/cost, missing or failed rows, and what remains blocked.
items.userSees: DONE summary reports Cell 03 execution status, actual provider usage/cost, row completeness, and remaining blocked cells.

happy.desc: DONE summary reports row completeness, actual usage and cost, and B-991d provenance.

edge.desc: Partial execution can close only with explicit blocked or partial status and missing-row inventory.

adversarial.desc: The story cannot mark DONE while implying Cell 06, Phase 2, paper wording, product gates, or playbooks are unlocked.

verificationEvidence.note: Status docs report Cell 03 completion, usage/cost boundary, row counts, and blocked Cell06/Phase2/playbook/product/paper scope.

verificationEvidence.command: node <assert done-summary formalComplete false and remainingWork present>
verificationEvidence.note: DONE summary explicitly records formalComplete=false for 10 terminal exhausted rows and lists remaining work instead of hiding partial/nonformal rows.
DONE summary notUnlocked marks automatic Cell06 execution, Phase2 decision, paper claim upgrade, model-agnostic/H-M1/H-M3 claims, product gate change, and playbook activation as not unlocked.
